title: OCaml Temporal Core bridge runtime telemetry document
description: Private, strict document passed to ocaml_temporal_core_v4_shared_runtime_new_with_telemetry_json (#500, #1161), at most 256 KiB. An empty object configures no exporter; at most one exporter may be configured. Temporal_base.Metrics_config renders it and writes every member explicitly. Runtime validators enforce the byte-length bounds and grammars documented in docs/reference/core-bridge.md, which JSON Schema can express only approximately (lengths here are character-based). An otlp document carries header credentials and must never be logged.

bind_address.description: a.b.c.d:port with canonical decimal octets, or [ipv6]:port without a zone; port 0 to 65535 without leading zeros (0 selects an ephemeral port).

endpoint.description: Lowercase http:// or https:// URL. Host: DNS name whose last label is not all digits, canonical dotted-quad IPv4, or bracketed IPv6 without a zone; optional port 1 to 65535 without leading zeros; no user information, fragment, or byte outside printable ASCII ! to ~. For http_protobuf it is the complete metrics URL; no path is appended.

headers.description: Request headers sent with every export; names unique. Values are credentials and never appear in a log or error message.

name.description: Must not end in -bin, start with grpc-, or be connection, content-encoding, content-length, content-type, host, keep-alive, proxy-connection, te, trailer, transfer-encoding, upgrade, or user-agent.

globalTags.description: Constant labels (Prometheus) or resource attributes (OTLP), in caller order; names unique.

name.description: Must not start with __ or be a label Temporal Core uses (activity_type, eager, failure_reason, le, namespace, operation, poller_type, quantile, service_name, status_code, task_queue, worker_type, workflow_type).

value.description: At most 256 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.
